method: single chat/completions call per model, 'What is 17*23? Reply with only the number.', max_tokens=400, temperature=0. Run twice: once with reasoning={'enabled': false}, once with provider defaults. A config counts as OFF-ABLE when the disabled call returns usage.completion_tokens_details.reasoning_tokens == 0 AND choices[0].message.reasoning is absent, while the default call returns reasoning_tokens > 0 (proving the toggle moved something).
